Kavita', filed by the respondent-husband, pending in the Family Court (Camp Court) Gohana, District Sonipat and she seeks transfer of the same to the Court of competent jurisdiction at Panipat.

sentences.text: As observed in the order dated 06.03.2025, despite service, the respondent did not make appearance on the said date.
Even, on the date prior to 06.03.2025 i.e. 12.12.2024, none had made appearance on behalf of the respondent.
Even today, none has made appearance on his behalf.

As such, the respondent is proceeded against ex parte.
1 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:033231 TA-1109-2024
Learned counsel for the applicant heard.
It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the marriage between the parties to the lis, had taken place on 19.10.2022, but no child was born from the said wedlock.
However, on account of the matrimonial discord, the parties are residing separate.
The applicant has no source of earning and is dependent upon her widow mother and brother.

On account of the matrimonial dispute, the applicant has got lodged an FIR bearing No.71 dated 09.03.2023, under Sections 323, 34, 376,
498-A, 506 and 511 IPC, at Police Station Quilla, Panipat, relating to which the respondent is facing trial in the Courts at Panipat.

Furthermore, she has filed the petition under Section 125 Cr.P.C. i.e.
MNT/52/2023 and the petition under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, which are pending in the Courts at Panipat and the respondent is making appearance in the same.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Also, it is submitted that the respondent is working as an ALM in the Electricity Department at Bichpari, Gohana.

Considering the aforesaid submissions, more particularly, considering the applicant to be having no source of earning and also considering the fact about three cases arising from the matrimonial dispute to be already pending in the Courts at Panipat, which are pursued by the respondent, the transfer application is allowed and the petition under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act i.e.
DMC/265/2022, titled 'Ravinder Vs. Kavita', filed by the respondent-husband, stands transferred from the Family Court (Camp Court) Gohana, District Sonipat, to the Court of competent jurisdiction at Panipat.

entities.text: Family Court (Camp Court) Gohana, District Sonipat
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The requisite record of the aforesaid case be sent by the Family Court (Camp Court) Gohana, to the District and Sessions Judge, Panipat.
2 of 3 Neutral Citation No:=2025:PHHC:033231 TA-1109-2024 Learned District and Sessions Judge, Panipat, shall assign the said petition to the Family Court, Panipat.
Even, the parties are directed to appear before the Family Court, Panipat, within a period of one month from today onwards.

(ARCHANA PURI)
10.03.2025 JUDGE Himanshu
